d:
Bollywood actor Amitabh Bachchan has received a threat that he will be blown up with a bomb. On November 26, Mumbai Mayor Ritu Tawde and Municipal Commissioner Ashwini Bhide received an email. The email contains threats of bomb blasts, as well as drone and grenade attacks, across the city—including at actor Amitabh Bachchan’s bungalow, 'Jalsa'.
Production: Supriya
Video Editor: Ravi Gangwar
